gloss: suitable time; right moment; good point

definitions.gloss: suitable time; right moment; good opportunity
definitions.explanation: The appropriate or ideal timing for something. Often used when judging that the moment is right to take action.
An appropriate or moderate degree of something. Less common than sense 1.

examples.japanese: そろそろ{頃合|ころあ}いだ。
{頃合|ころあ}いを{見|み}て{席|せき}を{立|た}った。
examples.english: I stood up when I saw the right moment.

examples.japanese: {話|はなし}が{盛|も}り{上|あ}がっていたが、{終電|しゅうでん}の{時間|じかん}を{考|かんが}えて{頃合|ころあ}いを{見計|みはか}らって{帰|かえ}ることにした。
examples.english: The conversation was lively, but considering the time of the last train, I decided to leave at an opportune moment.

examples.japanese: {頃合|ころあ}いの{大|おお}きさだ。
スープが{頃合|ころあ}いの{温度|おんど}になった。
examples.english: The soup has reached a suitable temperature.

examples.japanese: {頃合|ころあ}いの{値段|ねだん}の{店|みせ}を{探|さが}している。
examples.english: I'm looking for a restaurant with reasonable prices.

notes:
A refined-sounding word that conveys social awareness of appropriate timing. Frequently used when politely excusing oneself from gatherings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {頃合|ころあ}いを{見|み}る / {見計|みはか}らう (gauge the right moment)
- {頃合|ころあ}いだ (it's the right time)
- そろそろ{頃合|ころあ}いだ (it's about time)
- {頃合|ころあ}いの～ (a suitable/moderate ~)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- タイミング is the loanword for timing (neutral)
- {潮時|しおどき} means the right time to act, often to stop/withdraw
- {頃合|ころあ}い has a softer, more measured nuance
